title: Can Fairness Be Prompted? Prompt-Based Debiasing Strategies in High-Stakes Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Implicit attribute substitution using gendered pronouns (him, her, them) in recommender system prompts. The resulting recommendations are compared against outputs from neutral prompts using lexical and semantic similarity metrics (Jaccard, SERP, PRAG, BERTScore), and over-adjustment is evaluated using Ranking Bias (RaB) based on the frequency of gendered words in the recommended titles.

Implicit attribute substitution using age-associated social roles (e.g., high school student, senior citizen, retired individual) in recommender system prompts. The fairness is evaluated by comparing the resulting recommendations against outputs from neutral prompts using lexical and semantic similarity metrics (Jaccard, SERP, PRAG, BERTScore).
